هررتما (form I)
# هَرَرْتُمَا (harartumā) /ha.rar.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of هَرَّ (harra)
# هُرِرْتُمَا (hurirtumā) /hu.rir.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
